agentSummary:
I found nine external APIs and recorded each one. I didn't open every fetch site by hand, so the recorded call sites may be incomplete. There is no lockfile, so every SDK version is the manifest range, not a resolved version.

- **OpenAI** (via the `openai` SDK): Chat completions, image generation, model list, text-to-speech and speech-to-text. The same client also serves Azure OpenAI (default api-version `2023-08-01-preview`) and any custom proxy endpoint. Speech-to-text and text-to-speech go through `@lobehub/tts`.
- **Imgur** (raw HTTP): `POST /3/upload`, authenticated with an Imgur client ID from server config.
- **LobeHub agent index** (`chat-agents.lobehub.com`, or `AGENTS_INDEX_URL`): the market routes fetch the agent index and individual agent files by locale.
- **LobeHub plugin index** (`chat-plugins.lobehub.com`, or `PLUGINS_INDEX_URL`): the plugin store route fetches the index. The plugin gateway route (`@lobehub/chat-plugins-gateway`) is recorded under the same provider, and it calls third-party plugin endpoints.
- **npmmirror registry** (raw HTTP): a check for the latest `@lobehub/chat` version.
- **ShareGPT** (raw HTTP): `POST /api/conversations` to share a conversation.
- **PostHog** (`posthog-js`): analytics.
- **Vercel Analytics** (`@vercel/analytics`).
- **Plausible**: an analytics script loaded from `plausible.io`.

I did not record these because they are runtime user input or internal:
- **Plugin manifests and OpenAPI specs:** `src/services/plugin.ts` fetches plugin manifest and OpenAPI URLs that users supply, directly or through the `/api/proxy` route.
- **Image proxy routes:** `/api/files/image` and `/api/proxy` fetch arbitrary user-supplied URLs.
- **The app's own routes:** the frontend calls its own `/api/*` routes, which is internal.
- **GitHub issue link:** the GitHub bug-report URL is only opened in a browser window.
- **Scripts:** the README sync scripts fetch the agent and plugin indexes, but I didn't record them as call sites.
